responsibilities.name: Nightly Sync Service Health Check
responsibilities.instruction: Run the sync-service health check for the tachin-website project. Verify the Cloud Run sync-service is running, the Drive watch channel is active, and the GCS bucket has recent files. If the watch is expired, renew it. Report the overall health status.

context.success_criteria: Sync service is HEALTHY or any issues have been remediated. Health report delivered.
